name: comment-discipline
description: Stops Claude from writing comments that only make sense next to the diff — `// changed from foo to bar`, `// NEW: added validation`, `// for now` — which stop meaning anything once the change merges. A SessionStart hook injects the authoring rule on startup and after compaction; subagents get it by relay at dispatch, backstopped by a PostToolUse hook that injects it on their first edit. Enable per-repo or globally with /comment-discipline.
